elements.label: Figure 6.20
elements.title: Decision tree flowchart for classification
elements.details:
Nodes and branches:
- Root node: split on Y ≤ 13.75
  - Left branch (Y ≤ 13.75):
    - Split on X ≤ 14.55
      - Left branch (X ≤ 14.55):
        - Split on Y ≤ 8.45
          - Left branch (Y ≤ 8.45): Leaf node labeled Blue
          - Right branch (Y > 8.45):
            - Split on X ≤ 8.65
              - Left branch (X ≤ 8.65):
                - Split on X ≤ 4.2
                  - Left branch (X ≤ 4.2):
                    - Split on X ≤ 2.55
                      - Left branch (X ≤ 2.55): Leaf node labeled Blue
                      - Right branch (X > 2.55): Leaf node labeled Blue
                  - Right branch (X > 4.2): Leaf node unreadable
              - Right branch (X > 8.65): Leaf node unreadable
      - Right branch (X > 14.55): Leaf node labeled Red
  - Right branch (Y > 13.75): Leaf node unreadable
elements.summary: This flowchart shows the decision tree model used to classify points as Red or Blue by following branches based on conditions on X and Y coordinates, ending in leaf nodes with class labels.
